milestone: Embedded native Luau editor and Plasticity-inspired viewport

editor.implementation: Native egui TextEdit with Luau syntax highlighting, line numbers, system clipboard, and undo/redo
editor.run: Ctrl/Command+Enter validates and previews the unsaved buffer
editor.save: Ctrl/Command+S atomically saves; matching validated geometry is reused
editor.external_changes: Clean buffers reload automatically; conflicting disk and local versions are preserved until explicitly resolved
editor.close: Unsaved edits offer save, discard, or cancel
editor.default_launch: Mounting-bracket Luau workspace; --model selects another file; --rack opens the rack configurator

viewport.appearance: Neutral dark background, platinum studio shading, amber selected faces, dark CAD outlines
viewport.edges: Trimmed SMLib curves sampled at 0.02 mm chord tolerance; depth-tested screen-space quads
viewport.normals: Area-weighted smoothing within each CAD face; export mesh normals are unchanged
viewport.buffer_uploads: Mesh and edge buffers change only with geometry revisions; camera and outline controls reuse them

regressions: Atomic saves preserve local and external edits
Syntax highlighting preserves Unicode and Lua long literals
Box outlines contain exactly twelve CAD edges
Cylinder outlines omit its periodic seam and follow its circular rims

window.environment: Owned Xvfb display, native egui/wgpu, NVIDIA RTX 3070 Vulkan
checks: Paste unsaved draft without changing disk or preview
Run unsaved draft without changing disk
Save validated draft without uploading geometry
Type in editor without triggering viewport frame shortcut
Undo restores validated source without uploading geometry
Type error preserves previous valid geometry
Disk conflict preserves both versions and blocks save
Keep editor and save explicitly replaces external version
Cancel close preserves draft and saved file
Discard close exits without changing saved file
